note: Ps89 Davidic-covenant psalm (Ethan, 52v; Book III close). Passages: vow to sing of covenant-love v1-4; hymn to God's incomparable faithfulness + righteous throne + the BLESSED people who walk in his light v5-18; God's oracle establishing David v19-37; the anguished 'but now you have cast off' v38-45; 'how long?... remember' v46-51; doxology v52. Human IB: SING + make KNOWN God's faithfulness; the BLESSED people who KNOW the festal SHOUT, WALK in the light, EXULT in his name; the foes who would OUTWIT/HUMBLE/HATE the king; David's filial CRY 'my Father'; the children who FORSAKE/violate/keep-not the law (their TRANSGRESSION/INIQUITY chastened); the king who BECOMEs a scorn, covered in SHAME, his foes REJOICING; the reflection on human VANITY and mortality (who can LIVE and not see death); the servants MOCKED, the psalmist who BEARs the insults; the enemies who MOCK; the closing BLESSED-be-the-LORD. God's covenant/steadfast-love/faithfulness/establish/exalt/crush-Rahab/rule-the-sea/cast-off/renounce = qualifiers; throne/horn/Rahab/walls/Sheol imagery + names = standalone.
